text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Marvey and Teio! ☆ So,<n>presents? What'd
you get?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I got you something very marvelous.<n>☆ The
wrapping is marvelous, and the<n>inside is marvelous
too! ★

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, I know what it is—can't fool<n>Maya! And you,
Teio? Don't keep me<n>waiting!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Nghh, I spent a few days thinking<n>about it, but I
haven't been able to<n>decide. What's something
that would<n>be just as marvelous?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Oh, I know! How about I give you a<n>special peek at
a marvelous fighting<n>game technique of mine? The
secret<n>"Teio Spin"!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It's so good, no one's been able to<n>beat it yet. I'll
show you as many<n>times as you want. So, how
about it?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: No, no, I appreciate it, but... are you<n>sure?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
If you let me learn it, it's never gonna<n>work on me
again. ☆

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Marvelous! ☆ If I teach everyone how<n>to dodge it,
the whole school will be<n>marvelous! ★

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Aww man, I really messed up!
